data.smf.yaml:
logger:
  level: info
smf:
  sbi:
    server:
      - address: 0.0.0.0
        port: 7777
        advertise: open5gs-smf
    client:
      nrf:
        - uri: http://open5gs-nrf:7777
  pfcp:
    server:
      - dev: eth0
    client:
      upf:
        - address: open5gs-upf
  gtpc:
    server:
      - dev: eth0
  gtpu:
    server:
      - dev: eth0
  session:
    - subnet: 10.45.0.0/16
      gateway: 10.45.0.1
  dns:
    - 8.8.8.8
    - 8.8.4.4
  mtu: 1400
